title: A visual letter, a homage to Senegal and Africa
body: Safi Faye's portrait of Serer village life reads as a letter home, patient and clear-eyed, and it holds its place as the first commercially distributed feature by a sub-Saharan African woman.

title: You can't hide us
body: Nii Kwate Owoo turns the camera on the African artefacts locked in the basements of European museums, and asks who the archive is really for.
